solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Creature taking tumble: 'That's unfortunate,' one might say

indicators.note: what someone might say is heard rather than read, so the spoken words stand in for the written entry

parts.note: to tumble is to fall, and 'Oh dear' is the usual mild exclamation at a mishap

explanation.surface: Someone takes a fall and a sympathetic onlooker murmurs 'That's unfortunate'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one might say' tells you the phrase FALL OH DEAR is spoken, and said quickly it matches the name of the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The fallow deer is a European deer species, so it is a creature in the broadest sense.

clue.text: Vibes emanating from topless girl

definitions.note: plural vibes here means the single atmosphere a person or place gives off

indicators.note: topless means the top letter of the word is removed

parts.note: Laura is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Bad vibes come off a girl going topless.
explanation.definitionFit: An aura is the distinctive atmosphere or feeling surrounding someone, what slang calls their vibe.

clue.text: Woolly article sent in recently

indicators.note: sent in means the article is put inside the word for recently

parts.note: late can mean recently, as in 'of late'
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A knitted item was recently submitted, perhaps for a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Lanate is a botanical term for covered in fine woolly hairs.

clue.text: Linger around quietly on Iceland to see elks

indicators.note: around means the word for linger goes round the musical abbreviation

parts.note: to wait is to linger
p (piano) is the musical direction for quietly
IS is the international vehicle code for Iceland

explanation.surface: Staying quietly in Iceland in the hope of seeing elk.
explanation.definitionFit: Wapiti is the North American name for the large deer otherwise called elk.

clue.text: Freelance exhibits panache

indicators.note: exhibits means the word shows these letters within itself

explanation.surface: A freelance worker shows flair.
explanation.definitionFit: Elan is dash or vivacious style, the same flourish as panache.

clue.text: Offer support out loud: 'Way to go, rowers!'

indicators.note: out loud means the words are spoken, so the entry is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a route is a way to go, and a four is a rowing crew of four oarsmen

explanation.surface: A cheer of encouragement shouted at a rowing crew.
explanation.definitionFit: To root for a team is American slang for cheering it on or backing it.

clue.text: Mum's only eating fish and cheese

indicators.note: eating means the fish is swallowed inside the other pieces

parts.note: Ma's is the possessive of ma, mum
one can mean only, as in 'the one and only'
carp is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Mother eats nothing but fish and cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Mascarpone is a soft, rich Italian cream cheese.

clue.text: Henry's content with German I encountered admitting indefinite number for advancement

indicators.note: content means the contents of the name, its inner letters

parts.note: the possessive of the name Henry
ich is German for I

indicators.note: admitting means the word for encountered lets the number in

parts.note: met means encountered
n is the mathematical symbol for an unspecified number

explanation.surface: Henry is pleased to have met a German and is promoted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' looks like 'pleased' but means the inside of Henry.
explanation.definitionFit: Enrichment is improvement or betterment, a form of advancement.

clue.text: 1 Across could be flatter

definitions.meaning: a young deer of the species at 1 Across is called a ...
to flatter obsequiously, as a verb

explanation.surface: A cross-reference teaser that might also be read as an instruction to make something flatter.
explanation.definitionFit: A young deer of that species is a fawn, and to fawn on someone is to curry favour with flattery.

clue.text: GP's instrument?

parts.note: GP suggests a doctor's stethoscope, but GP is also the standard abbreviation for the large concert keyboard

explanation.surface: A question about the tool a family doctor carries.
explanation.walkthrough: GP looks like general practitioner, whose instrument would be medical; but GP is also the abbreviation for the big concert keyboard instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: Music publishers and auction catalogues abbreviate the large concert keyboard as GP, so it is literally the GP's instrument.

clue.text: Exercise caution initially in Haiti when touring

indicators.note: in places the first piece within the jumbled letters of the island's name
touring suggests moving around, so the letters of the island's name are moved around
initially means only the opening letter of caution is used

explanation.surface: Advice to take care while exercising on a holiday tour of Haiti.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when touring' rearranges HAITI to TAIHI, and 'initially' gives C from caution, which 'in' places inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Tai chi is a Chinese system of slow, flowing movements practised as a form of exercise.

clue.text: Section of thesis (emended) returned as punishment

indicators.note: returned means the hidden letters are read backwards
a section of the words is a run of letters taken from inside them

explanation.surface: Part of a corrected thesis is sent back to its author as a punishment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Section of' takes SISEMEN from 'thesis emended' and 'returned' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesis means retribution or downfall that is deserved, a punishment the wrongdoer cannot escape.

clue.text: Skin problem subverted her talents

indicators.note: subverted means overturned, so the letters are upset and reordered

explanation.surface: A skin condition undermined her gifts.
explanation.definitionFit: This rash of itchy weals, also called hives or urticaria, is a common skin complaint.

clue.text: Maureen, with new uniform in mind, is impressive

parts.note: Mo is a short form of the name Maureen
U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet
mental means existing in the mind

explanation.surface: Maureen, with a new uniform in mind, cuts an impressive figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Monumental means huge and awe-inspiring, like a great monument.

clue.text: Probe about husband's displacement

indicators.note: about means the word for probe goes round the abbreviation

parts.note: to sift is to examine closely, to probe
H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: An inquiry into why a husband was moved.
explanation.definitionFit: A shift is a movement from one position to another, a displacement.

clue.text: In flamenco, her nth go ruined 28's picture

indicators.note: ruined means the letters of the phrase are wrecked and rebuilt in a different order

explanation.surface: A flamenco dancer's latest attempt is spoilt.
explanation.walkthrough: 28 is STAG: Landseer's 1851 painting of a red stag in the Scottish Highlands is the picture meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Landseer's famous Victorian painting depicts a majestic stag, the subject at 28 Across.

clue.text: Virile sort of coachman can set off

indicators.note: sort here is a verb, arrange, so the letters of coachman are sorted
set off means the letters of can are removed from the mix

explanation.surface: A manly coachman sets off with a can.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' rearranges what is left of COACHMAN once 'set off' removes C, A, N.
explanation.definitionFit: Macho describes aggressively masculine behaviour, a virile manliness.

clue.text: Barber's quiet attentiveness

definitions.note: read as 'barber is', the verb: to barber is to cut hair

parts.note: SH is the call for quiet
to give someone your ear is to pay attention, so ear means attentiveness

explanation.surface: A barber's hushed, attentive manner with a customer in the chair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barber' here is a verb, and the 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: To barber is to trim hair, and shearing is cutting hair or wool closely.

clue.text: Spike's appearing in Dynasty

definitions.meaning: a spike or prong, such as the projection on a blade that fits into a handle
the ruling house of China from 618 to 907

explanation.surface: Someone named Spike gets a part in the television soap Dynasty.
explanation.definitionFit: A tang is the pointed tongue of a tool fitting into its handle; the Tang were a celebrated Chinese imperial dynasty.

clue.text: Make do with holding surgery in church

indicators.note: the church abbreviation holds the surgery abbreviation within it

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
OP is short for operation, a piece of surgery

explanation.surface: A doctor makes do by running a surgery in a church hall.
explanation.definitionFit: To cope is to manage or get by with what is available, much like making do.

clue.text: See 15 across
Where 7 might be spread in a time of good fortune?

definitions.meaning: the cheese at 7 Down could be spread on bread

definitions.text: in a time of good fortune?

explanation.surface: Where to spread cream cheese when things are going well.
explanation.definitionFit: Soft cheese is spread on bread, and the idiom describes a winning streak.

clue.text: Sheds where two females will gain employment wearing earmuffs inside out

indicators.note: wearing means the outer letters are worn around the other pieces
inside out here means the inside is out, leaving only the outer letters

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for female, twice
use means employment

explanation.surface: A garden-shed scene where two women find jobs while wearing earmuffs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside out' means the inside of 'earmuffs' is taken out, keeping just its first and last letters; 'Sheds' is a verb, not outbuildings.
explanation.definitionFit: To effuse is to pour out or give off, so sheds in the sense of emits.

clue.text: Shining belt crooked

parts.note: to belt or lam someone is to hit them hard
bent means crooked, physically or dishonestly

explanation.surface: A shiny belt that has been bent out of shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Lambent describes light that flickers or glows softly, so it means gleaming.

clue.text: Nothing following buffet? That's weird

parts.note: O is the round figure for zero or nothing
ff is the abbreviation for 'and following' pages
to buffet is to strike or beat

explanation.surface: No food left after the buffet: that's strange.
explanation.walkthrough: 'buffet' looks like a meal but is the verb meaning strike.
explanation.definitionFit: Something offbeat is unconventional or eccentric, hence strange.

clue.text: Briton oddly up-tight about the story of one's life

indicators.note: oddly means take the odd-numbered letters of the word

parts.note: pi, short for pious, means sanctimonious or narrow-minded
c (circa) means about

explanation.surface: A nervous Briton fretting over a life story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up-tight' looks like a reversal signal but is the definition of PI, crossword shorthand for pious.
explanation.definitionFit: A biopic is a biographical film, telling a person's life on screen.

clue.text: Reminder — note not included in present

indicators.note: not included means these letters are left out of the word before them

parts.note: mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A reminder that a note was left out of a present.
explanation.walkthrough: 'present' is the verb, as in presenting a bill.
explanation.definitionFit: To render a bill or account is to submit or present it.

clue.text: The sixth and last letter?

parts.note: a single Greek character is both sixth in its alphabet and transliterated as the last of ours

explanation.surface: A puzzle asking how one letter can be both sixth and last.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek alphabet's sixth character is written Z in English, our final letter.

clue.text: See 15 across
Reversed gracefully? It's too much!

parts.note: turned over means reversed, so over can stand for it
supply is the adverb from supple: lithely or gracefully

explanation.surface: A graceful backflip draws the verdict that it is too much.
explanation.walkthrough: SUPPLY here is the adverb from supple, rhyming with 'simply'.
explanation.definitionFit: An oversupply is an excess, a glut beyond what is needed.

clue.text: Droop around time for party

indicators.note: around means the drooping word goes round the time abbreviation

parts.note: to sag is to droop

explanation.surface: Wilting around the time for a celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: A stag party is a pre-wedding celebration for the groom, often just called a stag.

clue.text: An extra moment in pole dances — fantastic!

indicators.note: fantastic suggests something wildly imaginative, so these letters are rearranged freely

explanation.surface: Praise for a pole-dancing routine that runs on for an extra moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dances' looks like the anagram signal but is fodder; 'fantastic' does the rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Timekeepers occasionally add one second to clocks to keep them in step with the Earth's rotation.
